message.content: On February 24, 1815, Edmond Dantès, the eager and virtuous young mate of the *Pharaon*, returns triumphantly to Marseilles to marry his betrothed Mercédès, only to face the first stirrings of a dangerous conspiracy orchestrated by the envious Danglars and the heartbroken Catalan Fernand, who see his rapid rise in fortune and affection as a threat to be crushed.
